Transcript of interview with Wang Chung Village resident

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Staff manual on borrowing of items”
records.excerpt: “Staff manual on borrowing of items”
records.translation: 「借用物品的職員手冊。」

analysis.meaning: 以下規則屬博物館正式操作政策。
analysis.use: 它讓 Task 8 可用肯定語氣交代 cover、movers、costs 和 insurance。
analysis.rationale: 文件名稱不需寫給 Ms Ip，但會控制規則的權威。
analysis.treatment: 把適用條款轉成博物館將遵守的安排，不引用 section number。

matchParts: Staff manual on borrowing of items

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Section 3.2: Care of borrowed items”
records.excerpt: “Section 3.2: Care of borrowed items”
records.translation: 「第 3.2 節：借用品的保護。」

analysis.meaning: 本節集中處理 lender 的 safety 和 damage concerns。
analysis.use: 它把後面不同規則放在同一 care framework。
analysis.rationale: Section heading 沒有具體措施。
analysis.treatment: 使用相關條款回覆 Ms Ip，排除不適用的 basement rule。

matchParts: Section 3.2: Care of borrowed items

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “3.2.1 Displaying valuable borrowed items”
records.excerpt: “3.2.1 Displaying valuable borrowed items”
records.translation: 「3.2.1：展示有價值的借用品。」

analysis.meaning: 下面規則適用於公開展示的 valuable item。
analysis.use: Chang Yee Tak Plough 將在 exhibition 展出，因此 cover rule 適用。
analysis.rationale: Heading 只建立適用範圍，實際措施在下一句。
analysis.treatment: 直接寫 glass cover arrangement，不抄 section title。

matchParts: 3.2.1 Displaying valuable borrowed items

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “All borrowed items must be displayed with some kind of cover.”
records.excerpt: “All borrowed items must be displayed with some kind of cover.”
records.translation: 「所有借用品展示時都必須加上保護罩。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／正式保護規則

analysis.meaning: Museum policy 要求展示借用品時使用 cover。
analysis.use: Staff meeting 其後把一般 `some kind of cover` 確定為 glass cover，這才是 Task 8 最終安排。
analysis.rationale: 較後、較具體的決定已取代模糊說法；答案不需同時寫兩個版本。
analysis.treatment: 寫 `The plough will be displayed under a glass cover.`

matchParts: All borrowed items must be displayed with some kind of cover.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “This is to protect the museum from being blamed for damage to items”
records.excerpt: “This is to protect the museum from being blamed for damage to items”
records.translation: 「保護罩可避免博物館因物品受損而承擔責任。」

analysis.meaning: Cover rule 同時保護物品和釐清 museum liability。
analysis.use: 它解釋政策目的，但 Ms Ip 真正關心的是 plough 是否安全。
analysis.rationale: 在約 120 字電郵中，具體 glass cover 已足以消除風險；責任背景沒有獨立必要性。
analysis.treatment: 不談博物館避免被責怪，直接強調 glass cover 會保護 plough。

matchParts: This is to protect the museum from being blamed for damage to items

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “[Damage] may be caused by visitors touching or handling items without permission.”
records.excerpt: “[Damage] may be caused by visitors touching or handling items without permission.”
records.translation: 「訪客未經許可觸摸或拿取展品，可能造成損壞。」

analysis.meaning: Cover 所防範的主要展示風險是 unauthorized visitor contact。
analysis.use: 它說明 glass cover 怎樣回應 Ms Ip 的 safety concern。
analysis.rationale: Task 8 可直接寫保護措施；完整展開 visitor behaviour 會佔用篇幅，也沒有增加另一項安排。
analysis.treatment: 如需理由，可短寫 `to protect it from visitors`；核心仍是 glass cover。

matchParts: may be caused by visitors touching or handling items without permission.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “3.2.2 Transport”
records.excerpt: “3.2.2 Transport”

analysis.meaning: 以下條款直接回應 Ms Ip 對成本和 movers experience 的疑問。
analysis.use: 它把兩項 transport answers 聚在一起。
analysis.rationale: Heading 不需成為電郵句子。
analysis.treatment: 在同一段交代 qualified movers 和 museum-paid delivery/return。

matchParts: 3.2.2 Transport

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Movers with no experience ... must NOT be hired.”
records.excerpt: “Movers with no experience ... must NOT be hired.”
records.translation: 「不得聘用沒有經驗的搬運人員。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／運送人員資格

analysis.meaning: Museum policy 排除 inexperienced movers。
analysis.use: 它直接回應 Ms Ip 對 movers experience 的 concern。
analysis.rationale: 下一 clause 同時排除 untrained movers；答案應正面合併成 qualified arrangement。
analysis.treatment: 寫 `We will use experienced, trained movers.`

matchParts: Movers with no experience
must NOT be hired.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Movers ... who are not trained in handling borrowed items must NOT be hired.”
records.excerpt: “Movers ... who are not trained in handling borrowed items must NOT be hired.”
records.translation: 「不得聘用未受借用品搬運訓練的人員。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／專業訓練要求

analysis.meaning: Experience 之外，movers 也要受過 handling training。
analysis.use: 它補足 transport safety 的第二項資格。
analysis.rationale: 兩個負面禁令可合成一句正面承諾，意思更清楚也更省字。
analysis.treatment: 與上一句合併為 `experienced and properly trained movers`。

matchParts: Movers
who are not trained in handling borrowed items must NOT be hired.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Costs for the delivery ... will be paid for by the museum.”
records.excerpt: “Costs for the delivery ... will be paid for by the museum.”
records.translation: 「送往博物館的運費由博物館支付。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／去程費用

analysis.meaning: Lender 不需承擔把 plough 送到 museum 的費用。
analysis.use: 它直接回答 Ms Ip 的 cost concern。
analysis.rationale: Return cost 出現在同一句另一部分，兩程應一起寫，避免讓人誤以為只付單程。
analysis.treatment: 寫 `The museum will pay all delivery and return costs.`

matchParts: Costs for the delivery
will be paid for by the museum.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “[Costs for the] return of the item will be paid for by the museum.”
records.excerpt: “[Costs for the] return of the item will be paid for by the museum.”
records.translation: 「歸還物品的運費也由博物館支付。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／回程費用

analysis.meaning: Museum 亦承擔展覽後送回 plough 的費用。
analysis.use: 它完成 round-trip cost commitment。
analysis.rationale: 只寫 delivery 會漏掉 lender 的完整運送顧慮。
analysis.treatment: 與去程合併為 `delivery and return costs`。

matchParts: return of the item will be paid for by the museum.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “3.2.3 Items requiring special security”
records.excerpt: “3.2.3 Items requiring special security”
records.translation: 「3.2.3：需要特別保安的物品。」

analysis.meaning: 下一規則只適用於 special-loan items 在不展出時的儲存。
analysis.use: 它要求先檢查條件，不能看到 `security` 便自動加入 Task 8。
analysis.rationale: Chang Yee Tak Plough 的主要用途是 public exhibition；Task 8 沒有要求說明非展示期間的 basement arrangement。
analysis.treatment: 不獨立寫入，除非 task 明確詢問 storage outside display rooms；本題沒有這項要求。

matchParts: 3.2.3 Items requiring special security

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Items ... which will not be displayed in the museum display rooms”
records.excerpt: “Items ... which will not be displayed in the museum display rooms”
records.translation: 「這項規則適用於不放在博物館展覽室展示的 special-loan items。」

analysis.meaning: Basement rule 有明確適用條件：物品不在 display rooms 展示。
analysis.use: 它防止考生誤稱 plough 會一直存放地下室。
analysis.rationale: Plough 將用於 exhibition，Task 8 的安全重點由 glass cover、trained staff 和 insurance 完成。
analysis.treatment: 不提 basement storage，也不把這項 conditional rule 寫成必定安排。

matchParts: Items
which will not be displayed in the museum display rooms

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “[Such items] must be stored in the large underground storage facility in the basement.”
records.excerpt: “[Such items] must be stored in the large underground storage facility in the basement.”
records.translation: 「符合上述條件的物品須存放在地下室的大型地下儲存設施。」
records.typeLabel: 6 不採用／不符合本題用途

analysis.meaning: 它規定非展示物品的存放地點。
analysis.use: 只對另一種 storage scenario 有用。
analysis.rationale: Task 8 正在解釋展覽安排；加入地下室會造成 scope error，也可能讓 lender 誤解 plough 不會公開展出。
analysis.treatment: 完全省略。

matchParts: must be stored in the large underground storage facility in the basement.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “[Such items] must be securely stored under lock and key.”
records.excerpt: “[Such items] must be securely stored under lock and key.”
records.translation: 「符合上述條件的物品必須鎖好保存。」

analysis.meaning: Basement storage 的物品須上鎖。
analysis.use: 它依附於不適用的 non-display condition。
analysis.rationale: 不能把條件句拆走後當成 plough 的 confirmed arrangement；會議亦否決 permanent security guard。
analysis.treatment: 省略，保留已確認的 glass cover 和 trained handling。

matchParts: must be securely stored under lock and key.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “3.2.4 Insurance”
records.excerpt: “3.2.4 Insurance”

analysis.meaning: 以下條款回答物品損壞後的保障。
analysis.use: 它帶考生到 insurance timing 和 coverage scope。
analysis.rationale: Heading 本身沒有可寫安排。
analysis.treatment: 用一句交代 plough 在 transport 和 display 期間受保。

matchParts: 3.2.4 Insurance

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “All borrowed items must be insured by the museum”
records.excerpt: “All borrowed items must be insured by the museum”
records.translation: 「所有借用品都必須由博物館投保。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／保險責任

analysis.meaning: Museum 承擔替 plough 購買 insurance 的責任。
analysis.use: 它回應 Ms Ip 問 damaged or broken 時怎樣處理。
analysis.rationale: Insurance 的時間和 coverage 在後續 clauses，合併後才完整。
analysis.treatment: 寫 `The museum will insure the plough during transport and display.`

matchParts: All borrowed items must be insured by the museum

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “[Insurance must be arranged] prior to the finalisation of the transportation arrangements.”
records.excerpt: “[Insurance must be arranged] prior to the finalisation of the transportation arrangements.”
records.translation: 「運送安排正式確定前，必須先完成投保。」

analysis.meaning: Plough 不會在未受保的情況下開始 finalized transport process。
analysis.use: 它加強 lender 對風險管理的信心。
analysis.rationale: 約 120 字答案中，寫明 transport and display coverage 已保留實際保障；行政先後沒有獨立必寫作用。
analysis.treatment: 不詳述 finalisation procedure，保留 plough 會全程受保的結論。

matchParts: prior to the finalisation of the transportation arrangements.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Insurance will pay for any damage during the transport ... of the item.”
records.excerpt: “Insurance will pay for any damage during the transport ... of the item.”
records.translation: 「保險會賠償物品在運送期間的損壞。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／運送保障

analysis.meaning: Insurance coverage 包括去程和回程中的 damage risk。
analysis.use: 它直接處理 Ms Ip 的 transportation concern。
analysis.rationale: Display coverage 也屬同一 policy，兩者合併最有效率。
analysis.treatment: 寫 `insured throughout transport and display`。

matchParts: Insurance will pay for any damage during the transport
of the item.

records.sourceTitle: Staff manual on borrowing of items
records.heading: “Insurance will pay for any damage during the ... display of the item.”
records.excerpt: “Insurance will pay for any damage during the ... display of the item.”
records.translation: 「保險也會賠償物品在展覽期間的損壞。」
records.typeLabel: 1 Task 8 直接可用／展覽保障

analysis.meaning: Plough 在 museum 展示時同樣受 insurance protection。
analysis.use: 它完成 lender 對 `during its time there` 和 damage 的 concern。
analysis.rationale: 只寫 transport coverage 會留下 exhibition risk 未答。
analysis.treatment: 與 transport 一起寫，明確保留兩個 coverage stages。

matchParts: Insurance will pay for any damage during the
display of the item.

records.heading: “Minutes from museum staff meeting”
records.excerpt: “Minutes from museum staff meeting”
records.translation: 「博物館職員會議紀錄。」

analysis.meaning: 本頁記錄職員在正式會議中提出、接納或否決的安排。
analysis.use: 它提醒考生分清建議與最後決定；同一段中較後出現的集體決定具有較高效力。
analysis.rationale: 文件名稱不構成答案內容，卻控制其後證據的權威程度。
analysis.treatment: 不抄標題；用會議最後確認的安排，並排除被否決的建議。

matchParts: Minutes from museum staff meeting

records.heading: “Staff meeting of the Hong Kong Social History Museum”
records.excerpt: “Staff meeting of the Hong Kong Social History Museum”
records.translation: 「香港社會歷史博物館職員會議。」

analysis.meaning: 會議由任職該博物館的人員舉行。
analysis.use: 它確認會議內容屬館方內部資料，可用來判斷 Task 8 和 Task 10 的正式安排。
analysis.rationale: 三項答案已由題目交代機構身分，重複名稱不增加內容分。
analysis.treatment: 只把它當作來源背景。

matchParts: Staff meeting of the Hong Kong Social History Museum

records.heading: “Date: Tues. April 5, 2016”
records.excerpt: “Date: Tues. April 5, 2016”
records.translation: 「日期：2016 年 4 月 5 日，星期二。」

analysis.meaning: 會議在 4 月 5 日舉行，時間晚於 Ms Ip 4 月 1 日的電郵及 Ms O’Conner 4 月 2 日的投訴。
analysis.use: 它證明會議是在收到兩封電郵後作出回應，會議決定可更新先前的疑問和建議。
analysis.rationale: 日期用來判斷哪份資料較新，沒有需要寫入約 120 或 200 字的成品。
analysis.treatment: 採用 4 月 5 日會議確認的措施，不寫會議日期。

matchParts: Date: Tues. April 5, 2016

records.excerpt: “Venue: Museum Seminar Room 2”

analysis.meaning: 它交代會議舉行地點。
analysis.use: 只供會議紀錄存檔，與三項寫作任務的內容要求無關。
analysis.rationale: 地點不解答借用 plough、farmhouse 介紹或博物館問題與改善方法。

matchParts: Venue: Museum Seminar Room 2

analysis.meaning: Dr Jones 以館長身分主持會議。
analysis.use: 他其後同意執行的措施屬正式館方決定，並非一般閒談。
analysis.rationale: 職銜有助判斷權威，成品毋須列出與會者名單。

matchParts: Chairperson: Dr Jack Jones, Director

analysis.meaning: Howard 負責樓宇管理，Gau 負責公關及零售。

matchParts: Members: Limahl Howard, Building Management Director; Lara Gau, Public Relations and Retail

records.translation: 「秘書：Cindy Lau。」

analysis.meaning: Cindy Lau 負責會議紀錄。
analysis.use: 只完成文件格式。

matchParts: Secretary: Cindy Lau

records.excerpt: “[Dr Jones] suggested that a security guard should be permanently stationed by the plough.”
